title: 第11章 暗黑在蔓延第12章 正邪碰撞
slug: 圣殇天狱第1013章力战古神
content_zh:
万物生灵没有发现，
天上的太阳在以微弱到不可见的速度向白日变化，
星光·月辉越来越暗，
越来越冷，
日月星辰仍然运行不稳，
但带来的反应逐渐在各界万物慢慢的体现，
浮躁，自私，阴险，恶毒，直至毁灭，
这些都是超级神魔在未知界域大乱战，
打乱了宇宙诸天原有的法则平衡留下的因果，
或许会延续万亿年。
星域中，
未知界域流失到诸天万界的空寂风，
和那些战死的神魔气息混为一体，
一处处阴森恐怖的禁地正在缓慢形成！
~~~
幽暗的夜空下，
罪恶在一处处上演，
西山万年坟场，
漆黑如墨，冷月如勾，
阴风吹过，

夹带着一声声悠长的哀怨，
它们飘飘忽忽的声音夹带着那条黄水小沟沟的声音，
在这幽静的夜晚来回回荡，
几座花花绿绿的新坟被一个黑影刨开，
坟头那些在夜风中飘荡的黄白经幡，
仿佛是在为黑棺中尸体对黑影表示不满。
黑影弯弯的灰指甲已经进化成鹰爪，
更加锋利，
‘呯，’
黑暗中，
忽然一声巨响，
是黑影抬手就把黑棺一拳打爆，
鹰爪手一把抓向黑棺中的尸体，
张开尖尖的灰黑尖牙咬向还穿着黑色寿衣发萢的尸体，
‘咯吱咯吱’，‘咔嚓咔嚓’。
如在黑色幕布中的的乱葬岗，
传来令人毛骨悚然的咀嚼声音，
···
content_en:
All creatures have not discovered it,
The sun in the sky is changing towards the day at a speed that is so weak that it cannot be seen.
The starlight and moonlight are getting darker and darker,
It's getting colder and colder,
The sun, moon and stars are still moving unsteadily,
But the reaction it brings is gradually reflected in all things in all walks of life,
Impetuous, selfish, insidious, vicious, until destruction,
These are super gods and demons fighting in an unknown realm.
Disrupting the original law and balance of the universe and the heavens, the cause and effect left behind,
Maybe it will last for trillions of years.
In the star field,
The unknown realm is lost to the empty wind of all the worlds,
Mixed with the auras of those gods and demons who died in battle,
A spooky and terrifying forbidden land is slowly forming!
~~~
Under the dark night sky,
Evil occurs everywhere,
Xishan Wannian Cemetery,
The darkness is like ink, the cold moon is like a hook,
The dark wind blows,
With long lamentations,
Their fluttering sounds carry the sound of the small yellow water ditch,
Echoing back and forth in this quiet night,
Several colorful new graves were opened by a dark shadow,
The yellow and white prayer flags floating in the night wind on the tomb,
It seems to be expressing dissatisfaction with the black shadow for the body in the black coffin.
The dark shadow’s curved onychomycosis has evolved into eagle claws,
sharper,
‘Bang,’
in the dark,
Suddenly there was a loud noise,
It was the black shadow who raised his hand and punched the black coffin open.
The eagle's taloned hand grabbed the body in the black coffin,
He opened his pointed gray-black fangs and bit the corpse still wearing a black shroud.
‘Creak, click, click’.
Like a mass grave amid a black curtain,
There was a creepy chewing sound,
